comment_clean: Great place for a short stay in Porto! The apartment is clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything you might need. It’s conveniently located – just a 15-minute walk to the city center, very close to the metro, and there’s a supermarket nearby. We also had no trouble finding parking in the area. The only minor downside is a small bar on the corner – it can get a bit noisy at night when locals gather for drinks. But it didn’t spoil our overall experience. All in all, a great base for exploring Porto. Would recommend for a short stay!
evidence: the only minor downside is a small bar on the corner – it can get a bit noisy at night.

The host always responded instantly and we had a fabulous time here, thank you!

Only thing I will point out is that the front room with the single bed is street facing,so it is slightly louder in there on a busy night. The main bedroom is very quiet though. I loved my stay!

comment_clean: We stayed in Ricardo’s apartment for 4 nights, mid summer. We received very clear instructions regarding our arrival and the communication was very smooth. The apartment was very clean; I couldn’t find any dirty dishes or something familiar. The view from the apartment was great and the neighbors were very friendly. The apartment has a great view but is located on a very steep hill, therefore I won’t recommend it for elder people. All in all, we had a amazing holiday and we keep dreaming of the incredible view from the balcony!

comment_clean: Amazing location. Apartment is simple and very spacious. It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong - but it was only a night, so no problem.

comment_clean: The unit looks more beautiful and spacious than in the photos published. You have everything that you need for a traveler like us. The heating was working nicely. As an Asian, this is also the first time I used a European style bathroom/bidet and it was helpful for my bathroom needs. The room is not that soundproof though so you can hear footstep noises upstairs and some talking voices etc from the other room. Pedro's parents who welcomed us are also very kind, polite and made sure we have everything.
evidence: the room is not that soundproof though.
